ownership.kone: Revised Material tab is authoritative for USD cost and VK13 price; all Material-tab records are KONE.
ownership.nonKone: Separate approved catalog or explicit manual entry.
ownership.precedence: Do not override the revised Material tab with the small sample spares workbook.

validation: Catalog readers cannot update source costs, prices, classification or factors.
Source key includes approved source context; part number alone is not assumed globally unique.
Only one currently effective record per approved context is selectable.
Missing values, Excel errors, invalid currency/UOM/pricing units and overlapping records block import.
Zero cost and zero VK13 need an approved exception policy before activation.
KONE requires catalog lookup; Non-KONE may use manual amounts entered in estimate currency.
Pricing unit describes the VK13 price basis only after business confirmation; cost basis is separately confirmed before import.
CSTM scope requires package lookup; additional scope must not have a package lookup and still requires CSTM in the estimate.
Server owns catalog and conversion snapshots; preserve old snapshots on unrelated edits.
Do not round source costs before CAD conversion; source values above supported precision must be rejected, not truncated.
Non-terminating per-unit divisions require an approved rounding policy; retain source amount and pricing unit for recomputation.
Legacy rows remain readable; activate new calculation path only after backend migration is deployed.
Estimate child lookup delete behavior must preserve historical snapshots; do not cascade master deletion into estimate lines.
rolloutGates: Revised effective extract and pricing-unit/UOM/cost-basis contract approved.
Meaning of 1.23 and potential overlap with KONE charges reviewed.
Zero-amount, refresh and stale-data policies approved.
Idempotent schema deployment and rollback reviewed separately.
Deploy draft catalog API and pricing engine 2026.4 and pass non-admin integration tests before setting re_isenabled true.
No production import or write operation is provided by this schema definition.
